text: Nagato rains down Black Receivers and attacks, firing at enemies around him. pl:Kokuu
Battlerager armor, or simply spiked armor, was a rare variety of medium armor crafted by the dwarves of Mithral Hall and the Dwarven Valley.

Clad in Susanoo, Madara hurls his chakra sword at the opponent, swirling like a shuriken. During his battle with Hashirama Senju, Madara had cloaked Kurama in his Susanoo, and pierced through the beast's Tailed Beast Balls for a more damaging result.

Shinnō summons the Zero-Tails, then fuses with it and unleashes a massive attack with his shadow arms, trying to crush the enemy. However, the fusion is time-limited, and Shinnō is unable to perform more than two attacks.

This dōjutsu is more of an involuntary ability. It allows Shion to predict when someone is going to die. While the predicting is in process, her eyes take on a sacred geometric pattern, shifting somewhat like a kaleidoscope. The actual effect is allowing her soul to return to the past when she dies. When she does this, she informs her past self of the event and the people around her when this happens. She then tells one of these accompanying people that they will die. This prompts them to give their lives to protect her, effectively changing the future by trading their lives for hers. This therefore allows her to "predict the future" by partially controlling its outcome. She has been wrong only once, when predicting Naruto's death, where she protected him instead.
A bearded hammer was a special dwarven-made hammer that let a master smith trying to work a masterpiece be done with it faster.

Obito slashes the opponent with the Sword of Nunoboko, following with a scythe shaped from the Truth-Seeking Balls, and then shapes them into two large arms that forms a sphere of chakra at the palms.

B manifests two of Gyūki's tails to hold down his opponent, pulls himself towards his opponent, and lands a punch, his hand also transformed into Gyūki's. As he's about to land the hit, B releases his opponent, allowing to hit to knock them back.
A smaller scale version of the larger variant, Madara calls forth a shower of small meteors.
Battle Prowess, the personal weapon of the Faerûnian war god Tempus, was a +3 anarchic keen speed battleaxe.

Borsalino, more commonly known by his alias Kizaru, is an Admiral in the Marines. After Kuzan resigned from the Marines and Sakazuki was promoted to Fleet Admiral, Kizaru is now the only remaining Admiral from the previous trio. He was first mentioned by Nico Robin during the Straw Hats' initial encounter with Aokiji. Due to his actions and role, Kizaru is the secondary antagonist of the Sabaody Archipelago Arc and Marineford Arc, and the tertiary antagonist of the Egghead Arc.

Gerd is a giant from Elbaph and the doctor of the New Giant Warrior Pirates. She was formerly an S-Class ranked mercenary for Buggy's Delivery. She is a major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Elbaph Arc.

Issho, better known by his alias Fujitora, is an Admiral in the Marines. Once the captain of a guard force in the former Aoi Kingdom, he was conscripted through a World Military Draft during the two-year timeskip, being appointed to fill one of the Admiral vacancies caused by Kuzan's resignation and Sakazuki's promotion alongside his co-worker Ryokugyu. A proponent of "Humane Justice", Fujitora notably spearheaded a campaign for the abolishment of the "Seven Warlords of the Sea" system, which came to pass during the most recent Levely. Fujitora was first mentioned by Sakazuki when the latter was discussing plans to deal with Monkey D. Luffy and Trafalgar Law on Dressrosa. His following mission and actions on Dressrosa made him the first Admiral to physically appear post-timeskip and the secondary antagonist of the Dressrosa Arc.
The Bent Bow Bowyer was an excellent archery shop located in the Bell Market in Everlund.
Ko the Landslide is the leader of the Laotour Bandits. He is a major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates in the game One Piece: Great Hidden Treasure of the Nanatsu Islands.

Tot Musica, known as the "Demon King of Songs", is a monstrous entity created by the manifestation of people's negative thoughts. It is linked to sheet music that was sealed under Elegia, and can be summoned when a user of the Uta Uta no Mi sings its namesake song. It is the secondary antagonist of One Piece Film: Red.
The Warrior God is a legendary giant of Elbaph who wielded the hammer Ragnir and fought against the Sun God. His loyal companion was the ice squirrel Ratatoskr.

Beldora Thiiruin was the quiet and well-liked owner of the Maid of the Moors restaurant in Mornbryn's Shield circa 1356 DR. She was known to invest heavily in any venture that was endeavored upon by her neighbors.
Yakedoro was the second generation on Waford. As one of the Colossi, it maintained the barrier around the Tower of Heaven. It is a secondary antagonist of One Piece Odyssey.
Eber's Colossus is a unique Golem that can spawn in a vaal side area when the player has the prophecy.

() is a -type Legendary Pokémon introduced in Generation VII. It has three forms, and is known as UB-0 Black in the anime. Necrozma, as Dusk Mane Necrozma and Dawn Wings Necrozma, is the mascot of Pokémon Ultra Sun and Pokémon Ultra Moon respectively, and it is the main antagonist of the game, also the creator of the Z-Crystals and the power of the Totem Pokémon. It is also a member of the Light Trio alongside Solgaleo and Lunala.
Bevil Starling was a human fighter of West Harbor in Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR and a companion o the Kalach-Cha.

The Abomination was a Predalien that was born on BG-386. The Abomination was spawned when Specimen 6 defeated Wolf in the ruins on the planet and allowed the Predator to be impregnated by a Facehugger. Once fully grown, the Abomination began stalking and killing the human colonists of Freya's Prospect and the Colonial Marines dispatched to the planet. It was later discovered by another Elite Predator, Dark, who made it his mission to kill the creature at any cost.
Black Lady (ブラック レディ, Burakku Redi) is an evil adult version of Chibiusa from when she was corrupted by Wiseman (Death Phantom) with the lies in the Black Moon Arc.
Bakene (バケーネ, Bakeene) is a cat-like Monster who is the seventh of the Seven Great Monsters. He is trapped inside the violet Rainbow Crystal and is reborn inside Rhett Butler.
Beniago was a lieutenant and later the captain of Ship Kurth in Luskan. In reality he was a drow under the guise of a human who was a high-ranking lieutenant for Bregan D'aerthe.

Master Pharaoh 90 (マスター ファラオ ナインティ, Masutaa Farao Nainti) is an evil spirit, the power source of the Daimons, and the true antagonist of the Infinity arc. He was an evil spirit who wanted to make Earth a second home from the Tau Nebula.
"Saturn Planet Power, Make Up" is a phrase used by Hotaru Tomoe to transform into her standard and basic Sailor form as her alter ego, Sailor Saturn.

Nightmare (ナイトメア, Naitomea) is the main antagonist of the Soul series. He made his first appearance in Soul Edge, with his proper debut being in Soulcalibur. He is the host, wielder and living incarnation of the cursed sword, Soul Edge, the objective of most other characters in the story. Nightmare has been portrayed in the games as a violent and ruthless creature, constantly in search of souls to restore Soul Edge. He looks down on humans, considering them "pathetic" and "foolish", having no mercy for others, even to those who serve him, as shown in his Tales of Souls path where he considers killing his loyal servant Tira. Though his incarnation in V wants to take over the world rather than destroy it. What lies in his soul is Damnation and Destruction. In Soulcalibur V's promotional material he is referred to as The Symbol of Destruction.

Brother Benitus was a male human and a Cleric of Helm. He was a prelate of the Golden Fortress in Eshpurta, Amn, in the Year of the Shield, 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR, the Year of the Tankard He, along with younger priests of each faith, oversaw the chapels to Helm, Tempus, Torm, and Tyr that existed within the Golden Fortress.
Devours Children is an exceptionally powerful zergling. It took part in a zerg assault on terran colonists' Stronghold on Brontes IV.

The Escort Leader is a powerful Arbiter. It made an appearance on Aridas shortly after Judicator Kizrath acquired the Argus stone, along with a large number of carriers. Together they swept the terran and zerg forces out of the way.

Hybrid Experiment A626 was a Moebius hybrid created by Moebius Corps. It was thought that should it reach full power, there would be no stopping it from destroying the planet it was created on. It was augmented with terran technology, and created alongside Hybrid Experiment 9E57 and Hybrid Experiment 523I. General Carolina Davis called on the aid of two allied commanders to aid her in destroying it, and with the prototype Archangel the Balius, Davis and the commanders were able to destroy it before it could reach full power.

Hammer of the God Beldryn Klynrin was a priest of Tempus from Sembia who traveled often to Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron (sheriff) Buorstag Hlammythyl, i.e., from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR.

Hybrid Experiment 523I was a Moebius hybrid created by Moebius Corps. It was thought that should it reach full power, there would be no stopping it from destroying the planet it was created on. It was augmented with terran technology, and created alongside Hybrid Experiment A626 and Hybrid Experiment 9E57, and was the most powerful of the three. General Carolina Davis called on the aid of two allied commanders to aid her in destroying it, and with the prototype Archangel the Balius, Davis and the commanders were able to destroy it before it could reach full power.
Meat Eater is a powerful zergling. It participated in the destruction of the protoss and terran forces on Brontes IV.

Santa Claus, a resident of Planet Christmas, delivers presents to terrans across the galaxy from his red dropship. He does not deliver to other races such as protoss and zerg, however. This made him a target of Zergrinch and a band of protoss bandits, who captured him, trapping him in a stasis cell and locking down the planet. Jim Raynor sent a team, Santa Friends, in order to rescue Santa Claus, hoping to get high up on Santa's good-guy list. They were successful. Santa Claus commended them for "saving Christmas."
Belyssa Erstros was a whaler from Tarmalune and the captain of the ship Devastating in 1479 DR.

Tassadar was a protoss high templar and executor in charge of the expeditionary force which made first contact with the zerg. His forces also made first contact with the terrans when they sterilized the surface of Chau Sara in an effort to stem the growth of the zerg. Tassadar was extremely reluctant to sacrifice the terrans in order to destroy the zerg. He eventually lost his position as executor for sparing the terrans. Tassadar learned how to use the Dark Templars' energies and dared to bring them to Aiur. This alliance was responsible for the destruction of the dreaded Overmind, but not without Tassadar's sacrifice. His feats and selfless sacrifice earned him the title "Savior of the Templar."
The "Enforcer" is a Terminator that puts a barcode on Allison Young during the her imprisonment by Skynet.

before their fall, on the ledges of Gondolin|320x320px]] Lord of Balrogs was a title given to Gothmog and Lungorthin during the time of Morgoth. Gothmog served Morgoth as High Captain of Angband, and was the greater Lord of Balrogs in the First Age. He probably led the group of Balrogs that saved Morgoth from Ungoliant in Ered Wethrin. In the Dagor-nuin-Giliath, he mortally wounded the Ñoldor lord Fëanor. In the Nírnaeth Arnoediad, Gothmog killed Fingon, High King of the Ñoldor, with his axe and a little help from the lesser Lord of Balrogs, Lungorthin using a whip of fire to restrain the High King. Following the Battle of Unnumbered Tears, Gothmog captured Húrin, the lord of Dor-lómin, bringing the man into Morgoth's fortress of Angband where Lungorthin tortured Húrin with his whistling fiery whip. In the Fall of Gondolin, Gothmog was finally killed by Ecthelion, though the Elf was mortally wounded in the process. Lungorthin is not mentioned in later versions of the legendarium. ]
Beohram was a human fighter and member of Waterdeep's City Watch circa 1358 DR.
Lindenroot was an elderly Ent who lived in the forest of Fangorn during the past ages of Middle-earth. He was 2,000 years at the time of the Destruction of Isengard.

Amaterasu is a sun goddess of Japanese mythology, and the cheif deity of the Shinto cosmology. She was first recorded in the Kojiki, an early Japanese chronicle of myths, legends, hymns, genealogies, oral traditions, and semi-historical accounts. Amaterasu was later incorporated into Chaosium's role-playing game Call of Cthulhu, where she is classified as an Elder God. However, it was stated that this classification should be taken loosely and used as a basis of comparison with Cthulhu Mythos creatures.
Iaon-Thamungazoth, Lord of Chaos is a Great Old One worshiped in ancient Lemuria, one of the three primal lords of Lemuria and an aspect of the Triple God of Chaos.
Beluarion was human fighter of Baldur's Gate during the mid–14 century DR. He was a senior officer of the Flaming Fist circa 1358 DR.
Kuuko (also known as Cthugha) is an extraterrestrial entity from the fictional universe of the Haiyore! Nyaruko-san series.
Nyaruko (also known as Nyarlathotep) is an extraterrestrial entity from the fictional universe of the Haiyore! Nyaruko-san series.

Syththunu is a Great Old One (Dark Giant) created by DC Comics which appeared in the 6-part Eclipso Rising story arc with its first appearance in 2011 in issue #54 of Volume 2 of the Justice League of America comic series.
Berinvar was a fighter who served in the Athkatlan cell of the Harpers in the 1360s DR.

The Triple God of Chaos is a supernatural being and Great Old One mentioned in the stories of Thongor of Lemuria by Lin Carter. One of its aspects is Yamath the Lord of the Flames. Another of its three aspects is Slidith, the Lord of Blood.

Krok is Cybertron's star soc-... football player. This position isn't undeserved, as centuries of playing all-star mecha-soccer has given Krok the ability to cause earthquakes with his steps. His partner, Gatoraider, finishes off the unlucky fools caught in the aftershocks.

War Rotor is a Decepticon who appears in the game Transformers: Online. He fancies himself a collector of "exquisite taste", partaking in the collection of the severed limbs of worthy Autobot opponents. While his aerial skills against the Autobots are unmatched, War Rotor's Decepticon comrades can't overlook the creepiness that he gives off.
Bentan was a devoted evangelist of Ilmater who traveled the Sword Coast sharing the dogma of the Crying God during the mid−14 century DR.

Balefire Shintai is one of the Bile Shintai Discipline exclusive of the Scorpion Eater Dharma of the Kuei-Jin. Its non-tainted form is called Ghost-Flame Shintai. Among the shen, the Balefire Shintai is feared for the massive corruption it can unleash, warping local chi and even whole dragon nests. It is likely that the fires manipulated by the Scorpion Eaters are at least related to the Balefires known among the Western Werewolves. Chi Attunement: Strength
Big Joe Magarac is a totem spirit and the City Father of Pittsburgh.
Daityas are one of the sub-types of the Ogre seeming. These changelings are giants of Hindu myths. Theirs is the blessing of Cutting Might.
Beowen was a half-elven "Harper" agent who worked for a man named Teygan against the Zhentarim's grab for power on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR.

The Terrestrial Exalted, usually called the Dragon-Blooded and also called the Princes of the Earth, are the champions of the Five Elemental Dragons. For the last millennium and a half, they were the unquestioned rulers of Creation itself. Full rules for creating and playing as Dragon-Blooded characters are presented in Exalted: The Dragon-Blooded for Exalted First Edition, in Manual of Exalted Power: Dragon-Blooded for Exalted Second Edition, and in Dragon-Blooded: What Fire Has Wrought for Exalted Third Edition. Streamlined rules for Dragon-Blooded PCs are presented in Exalted: Essence.
Ellil, the Visage of the Winds is one of the Apocalyptic Forms available to the Fallen, specifically those of the House of Asharu.

The Eye, also known as the Queen of Mirrors or Fourfold Watcher, is one of the four Archigenitors of the Seers of the Throne and the Exarch of Space. He sends visions encoded in the most intimate aspects of a Seer’s life: code words in a lover’s speech, or extra instructions written into a plan to overthrow the tetrarch. She grants the Prelacy of Vision, his ministry is the Panopticon and her number is four. He is usually depicted as a great eye upon a throne, a pillar or a pyramid, or a sun disk veiled by clouds.
Benryn was a man that lived on the Sword Coast during the late 15 century DR.
Fides is a tenth generation Gargoyles from medieval France, in service to Aymeric de Saintonge, the Salubri Prince of Bourges.

Grandfather Thunder is a totem of Respect, strongly associated with the Shadow Lords tribe, of which he is the Patron Spirit. He is a powerful storm-spirit that demands a clear hierarchy. The Hakken also honor Grandfather Thunder, however they refer to it by the name Naru-Kami. Other names for the primordial storm-spirit include Taranis, Donner, Tlaloc, and the Emperor of Night.
Jameson is a Victorian-era wraith, who was killed by anarchists in Northern Ireland. In death he acts as a lawman of Little Five, Atlanta enforcing the Hierarchy's law.
Belmurl was a caravan guard in the Sword Coast during the mid–14 century DR.

Nova Elite known by the nickname Tötentanz (German: "Killing Dance"). Early in a series of 21st century conflicts in Central and West Africa known later as the Equatorial Wars, Kleisner was contracted by dictator General Akinlawon Ogolongwe of Nigeria to fight on his behalf for control of the country. When Team Tomorrow tried to intervene and put an end to the Equatorial Wars, T2M member Hiram "Slag" Goldberg was killed by Kleisner in the conflict that resulted. Kleisner's fate remains unknown.

Lady of Fate is one of the most powerful and enigmatic figures known in the Underworld, the imperatrix of the Legion of Fate and an independent power unto herself. Her seat is on the Isle of Eurydice, about 20 miles off the shore of Stygia.

Maqqabah was a Golem created in the Dark Ages by Rabbi Mordecai ben Judah using Kabbalistic magic. It was made from clay, and animated by means of a scroll (the Shem) in its brow that bore the Hebrew word for truth. The Golem could be destroyed by erasing one of the letters in this word, changing the word to 'death'. Its purpose was to protect the Jews of the Northern Quarter of Prague. The Cappadocian vampire Garinol wished to learn the secrets of the Golem so that he could better protect his haven at Petrin Hill Monastery, but to prevent this from happening his treacherous childe Mercurio afflicted the Golem with grave rot. As a result, the Golem went mad, destroying buildings and slaughtering the Jews it had been built to protect, including the Rabbi. When Mercurio's plot was discovered, the Brujah Wilhem Streicher and Christof Romuald ventured to the Northern Quarter and destroyed the Golem. They recovered the Shem and brought it to the Rabbi's son, Mendel, who offered it to the Cappadocians to help them in their own research on Golems.
Beldimarr was a Harper operating as a caravan driver in the Sword Coast during the mid-14 century DR.
Marcus Fulgaurator is a powerful Roman sorcerer who unleashed Lightning Scourge upon the rebellious Celtic sorcerers of the British Isles in 43 AD.
Matshishkapeau ("Fart Man") is a powerful spirit from Innu myth.
Michael or Michaelius, Seraph of the Flaming Sword and Voice of God is the Celestial Name and title of the head of the true First House of the Elohim, and the lead messenger of God Himself.
Benante the Butcher was a Netherese fighter who owned Benante's Butchery in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in .

Michael, born Mi-ka-il, and also known as Beshter, was a powerful Toreador methuselah that inspired the Dream and ruled Constantinople along Antonius and the Dracon. He had delusions of divinity, and instilled in Vykos the need to continue his quest for building Heaven on Earth. He was diablerized by Mary the Black in 1204 CE.
North Wind, sometimes also known as Ice Wind or the Cruel One, is the Patron Spirit of the Galestalkers tribe of Garou.

Sarah Chandler was the first person to die in Atlanta. Dying as a child, Sarah is one of the oldest and most powerful Wraith in the Necropolis. Due to her extended time as a wraith, she has become the Anacreon of the Emerald Legion.
Bengel was a corrupt Netherese fighter who served as an Underchief at Constabulary Branch Two in Eileanar before its destruction in .

Known also as the Lawgivers, the Solar Exalted are the champions of the Unconquered Sun and the most powerful of all the Exalted. Once the masters of Creation, the Solars were betrayed and usurped by their trusted advisors and soldiers, the Dragon-Blooded. Most Solars were unable to be reborn until recently, and the Wyld Hunt was organized to slay those few who did find a way to reincarnate. While the other Exalted may be able to exceed the Solars in narrow domains, the Solars have the most flexibility, a wide array of powerful Charms and sole access to Solar Circle Sorcery. The only Exalted who are their equals are arguably the Abyssal Exalted, their dark reflections.

Sopdet, also known as Sothis, was the Aeon of Time during the . Though she technically ruled alongside Set of Fate, the latter was not bound to Astral Space and left Sothis to rule the throne of Acanthus alone. For reasons unknown, in modern times, Sopdet no longer acts as the Time Aeon. In her stead is Gloriana Temporae.
Susano-o is the Japanese god of the sea and storms, and a member of the Amatsukami pantheon.
Beldar the Brave was an adventuring fighter in the mid-late 14 century DR.
The Tek-Tek is a former ghost that became something else over time: more an idea of death itself.
Tepet Arada is an Air-Aspected Terrestrial Exalted, a disgraced general who has turned his back on the Realm. He is the signature Air Aspect.
Teshra-Gemet, the Red Sparrow (O Pardal Vermelho), is the most powerful of the Arisen in Rio de Janeiro.
Bestial fire archons were fire elemental creatures, a version of fire archons, bound by the armor forged in the form of a drake.

Triatic Wyrm is a term often used to describe the joint manifestation of the unholy trinity of the Wyrm: the three heads known as the Wyrm of Calamity, the Wyrm of Consumption, and the Wyrm of Corruption.
Urbiphages are extremly rare and extremly powerful entities from beyond this world. Like vampires, they feed on life, albeit on a much larger scale: Urbiphages feed on cities.
Water Wyrms, also known as Esmusgal, are powerful sea serpent spirits. The youngest among them have been known to act as totems for seafaring Uratha packs.

The Bent Bow might refer to: * Bent Bow Bowyer, an archery shop in Everlund. * Bent Bows, a bowyer's shop in Hill's Edge. * Bent Bow, a tavern in Arabel. * House Bentbow, a defunct merchant house of Ravens Bluff
The White Wolf (Ice Elemental) is a flesh-borne spirit Kami that roams the Arctic Cicrle.

Zhyzhak has controversially been regarded as the most powerful werewolf of the World of Darkness. She is an insane homid Black Spiral Dancer Ahroun Legend, who dresses in bizarre dominatrix gear which she never bothers to dedicate.

Aborius is a water fury located at the Throne of the Elements in Nagrand. She's currently not involved in any quests. If you attacked somebody around her, she would one shot you. Shortly before the Cataclysm, Thrall journeyed to Garadar to discover why the elements of Azeroth were so afraid. During this event, Thrall would communicate with Aborius to see if the fury could enlighten him to what was causing the elements their fear. In response, Aborius gave him advised to not become afraid of anything in his journey to save his world.

Bishop was a skilled and deadly human ranger from the Sword Coast North in the mid–14 century DR. During the Shadow War, he notably traveled with the Kalach-Cha and aided them in their quest before eventually betraying them at the Siege of Crossroad Keep.
Akasha is a level 80 giant sea serpent that swims in the sea serpent swarm above Gorrok's Lament in the Kelp'thar Forest.
Aluri is a red drakonid flight master located in Valdrakken.

Amnennar the Coldbringer is an elite lich boss found in Razorfen Downs, sitting atop the Spiral of Thorns, a mountain of massive spiked vines infested with his undead minions around a brazier burning with cold flames.

The Black Horde was an orc horde that assaulted the Sword Coast in the 1235 DR. It was the largest orc horde in the history of Faerûn by the late 14 century DR. The Black Horde besieged countless settlements in the North and threatened kingdoms far south of it as well. This conquest was of such significance that the year 1235 DR would become referred to in the Roll of Years as the "Year of the Black Horde".

__NOTOC__ Andrestrasz is a sleeping red dragon found in a cave on the southern coast of Ahn'Qiraj: The Fallen Kingdom. After the Fourth War, Rexxar tracked him and with Zekhan passed by the empty Oceanmane Village and entered Andrestrasz's lair, as the mok'nathal wanted to follow up on rumors of the dragon. Perhaps bored and lonely, Andrestrasz let them live, and Rexxar asked him why he stayed in the village. The dragon insisted they call him Andre, and responded that he couldn't rejoin the red dragonflight until his old Oceanmane friend returned from his hunt, even though it was clear that the tauren brave wouldn't return. Zekhan promised Andre to visit him soon, and the dragon promised he won't roast him the next time.
Ararat was a warrior. His blood was infused with glimmering steel, spilled by dragons, gods, and demons. Even from beyond, he protects his friends.

The unnamed father of Aratas was a huge and powerful earth elemental who appeared in Maraudon after the Cataclysm. He created a new race of centaur known as the perfect ones, led by Aratas, with the intent of conquering Azeroth and purging it of its other mortal races. Both the elemental and his creations were destroyed by the Garad'kra.

Bhaem Shumokh was a human male and the head of the Shumokh mercantile family in Eshpurta, which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR, the Year of the Tankard.. The Shumokh family made their fortune in the blacksmithing and armor business, but kind-hearted Bhaem chose to become a musician and lute-maker, which turned out to be quite lucrative.
Asennu is a titanic watcher encountered by Alliance and Horde champions on Un'gol Ruins.
__NOTOC__ Aurastrasza is a red dragon quest giver located at Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.

Azzinoth was a powerful doomguard commander of the Burning Legion slain by Illidan Stormrage during the War of the Ancients, 10,000 years ago. He was the original wielder of Illidan's warglaives, which the demon hunter claimed after slaying his foe.

The Blackdagger Bandits were a powerful bandit group that operated on the Sword Coast North in the late 15 century DR and were the most successful and notorious bandits of the area at the time. It was named for and led by the brothers Malus and Traven Blackdagger.
__NOTOC__ Azurewing Keepers are blue dragonspawn located in Azsuna. They also participate in the Burning Legion's Assault on Azsuna.

Balacgos was an elder offspring of the great aspect Malygos. As a caretaker of magic, Balacgos created a cerulean cube to deal with the unharnessed latent magic energy found throughout Azeroth, in an effort to keep it out of the hands of undisciplined practitioners of the arcane. The cube was designed to absorb such magic and hold it in reserve till a time the blue dragonflight had need of it. But Balacgos miscalculated and upon activating the cube the device absorbed his magic, leaving the dragon a lifeless husk. The cube came to be known as Balacgos's Bane.

__NOTOC__ Thunderaan, Prince of Air, son of Al'Akir the Windlord was attacked by Ragnaros the Firelord, in an attempt to heighten the already impressive power the fire elemental held. Ragnaros succeeded, though Thunderaan's power could not be completely taken into his form. What remained of Thunderaan was placed in a talisman of elemental binding, which was broken into two pieces, then given to the Firelord's two lieutenants, Baron Geddon (left half), and Garr (right half). These two halves are known as the Bindings of the Windseeker. The bindings are required for Thunderaan the Windseeker (quest), leading up to the forging of Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker.

The Black Sword was a title within the government of Archendale, one of the three anonymous Swords of Archendale. The Black Sword was the most prominent of the Swords, supervising the militia of Archenbridge.

Bigguns (also known as dredger brutes or dredger giants) are multiple dredgers that have been reshaped together into huge, hulking creatures capable of impressive feats. They consider bugs, ash, glass, and what appear to be naaru fragments snacks. During times of battle, their ability to move allies across the field by tossing them makes bigguns a valuable asset. They generally appear to be less intelligent than dredgers, referring to themselves in third-person. Rendle charitably notes that they "can be... a bit much sometimes."

Blight-Howl is a darkhound located at the Marris Stead in the Eastern Plaguelands. It fought alongside Nathanos Marris when he was attacked by the Argent Crusade, and the adventurers of the Alliance and Horde. Blight-Howl and Plaguefang charged at Tyrande Whisperwind when she appeared, but the hounds were quickly struck and killed by her starfall spell.

The blue dragonflight is a draconic organization led by the eponymous blue dragons to uphold their creed of managing and watching over the flow of magic and arcane in the world of Azeroth. During the ordering of Azeroth, the titan Norgannon blessed Malygos and his flight with power over the arcane and the duty of ensuring it would never be abused. Malygos and his mate Sindragosa ruled the blue flight until the War of the Ancients, when the crazed Deathwing used the Demon Soul to wipe out the majority of the flight, leaving only Malygos and precious few eggs left. The event left Malygos both weakened and depressed. The flight slowly but surely recovered over the millennia, until the ambitious young dragons Kalecgos and Tyrygosa attempted to bring Malygos out of his stupor. They were successful, but rather than lead their flight as the noble and wise leader they had hoped for, Malygos was appalled at what he saw as the overuse of magic in the world. Rallying his flight and all the mages supporting his cause, Malygos began the Nexus War, seeking to subjugate or wipe out all magic usage on Azeroth. He was opposed by many mortal organizations, such as the Kirin Tor and the other dragonflights under the Wyrmrest Accord; the war ultimately ended in the Aspect's demise. After the death of Malygos, the blue dragonflight had to choose a leader who would become the new Aspect of Magic. It was ultimately narrowed between Malygos' son, Arygos, and the dragon Kalecgos; though the former ul
The Black Maw Bog was a wetlands surrounding the Huntinghorn Water, a stream out of the foothills of the Sword Mountains in the Dessarin Valley region of the Savage Frontier.
Bythius the Flesh-Shaper is a Level 80 elite flesh giant who roams The Avalanche in Sholazar Basin, accompanied by the plague-dogs Cerberon and Glonn.

:"Hope is the sun behind a stormy sky. :Ever in the heart, but veiled to the eye." Chi-Ji the Red Crane is one of the four creatures known as the August Celestials who watch over Pandaria. Chi-Ji watches over the Valley of the Four Winds and Krasarang Wilds and is sometimes referred to as the Southern Celestial or the Spirit of Hope. As such, he is served by the Crane Wing order. Chi-Ji also takes the guise of Fat Long-Fat.

Chrono-Lord Epoch is sent by the leader of the Infinite dragonflight to make sure he mixes the past events in Old Stratholme. In World of Warcraft, he is the third boss of the Culling of Stratholme; an instance introduced in .
Bjornin was a brave paladin who lived on the Sword Coast in the mid–14 century DR.
Cinder is a cloud serpent located in The Jade Forest. It is training with .

__NOTOC__ Cyrukh is an elemental lord that has been empowered by and the :Cipher of Damnation, driving it insane. Gul'dan intends to use Cyrukh to sever the link between the elements and , something that his main timeline counterpart succeeded in.
Daggin Windbeard is a Wildhammer dwarf flight master located at Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds. He was attacked during the Horde assault but was rescued by Alliance adventurers.
Binkos was a messenger who lived on the Sword Coast during the mid−14 century DR.

__NOTOC__ Darunga is an ettin, a giant humanoid loyal to the Twilight's Hammer. He is responsible for the attack on the Dunwald clan's town in the Twilight Highlands, leading the Twilight forces that brought it to ruin, settling buildings ablaze and slaughtered the inhabitants. Flynn Dunwald and his brothers fight the monstrosity during the below quest, aided by players at the Dunwald Town Square.
__NOTOC__ Deth'tilac is a massive rare fire spider found by the Forlorn Spire in the Molten Front.
Destinisera is a green dragon located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
The Bhaalspawn Crisis, also known as the War of the Bhaalspawn, was a great conflict that broke out on the Sword Coast and the Lands of Intrigue in the .

Earclopses are a species of giant humanoids that are notable for having an ear for a head. The Earclopes appear in "The Silent King" and are used as an army by Xergiok, a deposed goblin king, in an attempt to retake the Goblin Kingdom.

is the son of Flame King and the brother of Flame Princess. He first appeared in the episode "Jake Suit," in which Flame Princess introduces him as her older brother who works in the military. He reappeared in "The Cooler," urging his sister to blow up the Candy Kingdom as sugar burns hotter and faster with extra calories, and stating that they are "trash" people. By the end of the episode, he was still urging his sister to do that, to which she responded with a pat on his shoulder.
* The adult amethyst dragon Gembright claims the northern waters of the Channel Lock as her own. She occasionally entertains Netherese arcanists who wish to discuss magic or dragons with her.

The Black Blade and Bloody Boar was a rough-and-tumble tavern that was renowned as perhaps the most unsavory establishment found in city of Mulmaster. It also served as a bloody area run one of the city's most notorious criminals, Gethmedra Darmov.
* Ioulaum names the arcanist Noanar as Netheril's "Fire Warden" because of his extensive knowledge of fire magic.
* Venominhandar, a great green wyrm, begins his reign of terror over the Emerald Vale of Cormanthor.
An abominable yeti was a huge and monstrous yeti that was several times more powerful than a regular tundra yeti.
The Black Bow was a bow from the ancient Imaskari Empire. As of , it might be found within the Star Houses of Solon.
Abyad Abd al-Bas was a famed mamluk of the Valiant Mamluk Society from the Free City of Qadib in north Zakhara.

Absalme was a henchman, or perhaps pet, to the Talontar blightlord Damanda in . She was 'elf thin', wore a gown of white leather, and played a flute of fused humanoid bones. After she tried to grab Araluen and lift the child by her hair, the infant brushed her wrist; she was instantly annihilated by blinding light.
Aerie was an avariel spellcaster that lived in the nation of Amn during the mid–14 century DR.
Billhooks were a type of agricultural tool in the Realms that could double as an improvised weapon.
Aghazstamn was a blue dragon dracolich. He was a member of the Cult of the Dragon and an acquaintance of Symgharyl Maruel.
Aevendrow, or starlight elves, were an extremely rare and distinct type of drow that lived in the frozen North.
Acuakvacaesin was a peaceful green dragon residing in the Moonshae Isles.
The Black Gauntlet was an adventuring company active during the 13 century DR.
Aflame was an apprentice wizard of Malchor Harpell during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Aeger was an infamous giant bear who terrorized the Sword Coast several centuries before the 14 century DR.
Aeristhax was a pseudodragon who became an ally of the Uthgardt sorceress Saskia in .
Black Logan was reputed to be a warlord of the Sword Coast North early in its history and the commander of Black Logan's Keep in the Red Rocks in the Sea of Swords.
Al Dimeneira was a powerful angel (a movanic deva or a solar) of the Upper Planes who once tried to defeat the power of Crenshinibon, but without success.
Akil Festir was a powerful and ambitious wind mage who resided in Huzuz, the City of Delights.

Air elemental myrmidons, otherwise known as air myrmidons or air archons, were a variety of elemental myrmidon, beings created by conjuring and bonding elementals—in this case of elemental air—into ritually created armor. They acted as servile weapons of war.
The Bitch Queen was a ship and floating temple to the goddess Umberlee that sailed the seas along the western coasts of Faerûn during the Era of Upheaval.
Arlavaunta was a green dragon in the Wizard's Reach during the mid–8 century DR.
Aumvor the Undying was an ancient Netherese lich and archmage who was infamous since Netheril's Age of Discovery for his unmatched mastery over necromancy.
Aurelia was a vampire spawn and one of the favorite "children" of the vampire lord Cazador Szarr, who resided in the Szarr Palace of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Black raptor staff was an enchanted druidic staff found in the jungles of Chult in the late 15 century DR.
Baazka was the powerful pit fiend responsible for the Second Dragonspear War of the mid–14 century DR, that later allied with the Red Wizards of Thay in Daggerford circa the .
Azharul was a dragon god who lived in Dragon Eyrie, reputed for his mastery of magic.
Bal'alak, or Balalak the Ferocious, was a massive dire boar that terrorized the inhabitants of Samargol in the late 14 century DR.
The Black Swan armor was a unique enchanted set of delicate enameled bluish-black plate armor from the Hand of the Seldarine citadel.
Baku were powerful psionic outsiders native to the Outlands.
Banak was the most powerful evil priest in all the Bloodstone Lands as of the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Barbanas was a wizard in the mortal world for a period of time, but lived a second life of sorts as a flameskull after his death. He dwelled on the plane of Avernus in the Nine Hells, under the dominion of the night hag Mad Maggie.
The Black Blade was the name given to a powerful brigand operating in the Eastern Heartlands in the mid–14 century DR.

Barrowes were a kind of undead hill giant. By the , they were seen among the peaks of the Giant's Run Mountains in increasing numbers, supposedly due to the Dodkong's campaign to expand Cairnheim's influence.
Bar was a clay golem inhabiting the city of Zhentil Keep during the late–14 century DR.

A beholder, sometimes called a sphere of many eyes or an eye tyrant, was a large aberration normally found in the Underdark. These large, orb-shaped beings had ten eyestalks and one central eye, each containing powerful magic. Powerful and intelligent, beholders were among the greatest threats to the world.
Black Urchin was a type of enchanted shield forged in the Underdark in the likeness of blackblood urchins.

Bartholomew Blackdagger was a notorious pirate king that ruled over the Pirates' Skyhold earthmote and used his fleet of skyships to raid the Sea of Swords for over a decade during the 15 century DR. He and his vicious crew were famously cursed by the black dragon Garrundar, doomed to remain within their floating isle as cursed undead thralls for all time.
Bazidan, also called Bazidan of the Flames was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR.
Black slaadi, also known as void slaads, were a rare and powerful variety of slaad with unparalleled powers of entropy.
Black dragon bolt was an arcane conjuration spell that blasted the target with corrosive acid, similar to the breath weapon of black dragons.
Bloodburn, also known as bloodboil, was a spell that could only be cast by dragons.

Bodhi was an exiled elf from Suldanessellar who was later transformed into a vampire. She and her "sibling" known as "the Exile" Joneleth Irenicus orchestrated a grand scheme to steal the divine essence of the dead god Bhaal, and take revenge on their former homeland.
Bonesnapper was a griffon-in-training to serve as a mount for a Griffon Cavalry rider as of the year 1492 DR.
Bicentan Sail was a ship of Sembian ownership on the Sea of Fallen Stars. Like other Sembian mercantile and naval vessels, it was named for a coin, namely the gold bicenta of Calimshan.
Blue abishai were the second-highest of the abishai devils. Like their true dragon counterparts, the blue dragons, they had a supernatural affinity to lightning and were highly intelligent.

Bonehammer was a henchman, or perhaps pet, to the Talontar blightlord Damanda in . He was a pale giant clad only in tattooed grotesque scenes of depravity, who sometimes spewed poems. He fought on his mistress' side when Marrec's party caught up to her, though both vampires fled the fight when it turned against them. Bonehammer was ultimately speared by a shaft of natural sunlight while fighting Gunggari Ulmarra at his mistress' hideout.
Braxow was a stone giant thane sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
The Black Knight was a magical chess piece that could be used to summon a fighter to support its owner.
Branta Myntion was a wizard's apprentice inhabiting the city of Waterdeep during the mid-to-late 14 century DR. By , she haunted Halaster Blackcloak's tower in the Undermountain as a demilich.

The Bosatsu Jizo was a lawful good demigod from Kara-Tur focused on the welfare and education of children. It typically appeared in the guise of an ancient human monk carrying a non-magical wooden bo staff, though it could take the form of any intelligent creature. It was a master of all defensive martial arts.
Brightlightning Dragonsbane was the Swordmaster of the Hordes of the Tangled Trees from Yuirwood and Lady Lonereed Silverleaf's escort-of-the-year during the Festival of Blades of 1217 DR.
Bindle's Blade was an inn in the Lower Heart of Skullport in the late 14 century DR.
Burnbones were high level members of the Church of Cyric whose mortal frames had been dissolved and transformed from being infused with a portion of his divine power.
Calhyar, or Calhyar of the Winds, was the third senior Witches of Rashemen in Mulsantir and a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR.

Camnod the Unseen was a mysterious entity purported to be one of the ancient Seven Lost Gods and one of the elder evils. Camnod the Unseen was one of seven demipowers who were defeated by or submitted to the god Bane, the Black Lord, in ancient times, among Borem of the Lake of Boiling Mud; Maram of the Great Spear; Haask, Voice of Hargut; Tyranthraxus the Flamed One; and two more whose names were lost to history. In Urgund's Description of Darkness, an account by Urgund of his imprisonment in the lower planes, these five entities were "those who fell down and became servants of the great lord Bane" and later sat in his Hall of Minor Courtiers as lesser powers.
The Black Stag axe was an enchanted greataxe of unknown origins found on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR.
Cernd Shattermind was a hybrid illithid dwarf living in Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR.

Cave trolls were an instinctual, less intelligent sub-species of trolls that were predominantly found in underground lairs. Like others of their kind, cave trolls had an insatiable appetite and would endlessly hunt. They were brutal hunters, who relied heavily on their instincts, pouncing on their prey, raking and rending them with their claws.
Ceptienne was an intelligent and powerful sorceress that dwelt at the top of the Star Mounts.

Biff the Understudy was a human male fighter and an actor in Raelis Shai's theater performance at the Five Flagons Inn in Athkatla in 1369 DR. He served as an understudy for Haer'Dalis, who was absent. Biff messed up his lines, prompting booing and causing the play to be abandoned.
Chatulio was a copper dragon who helped Dorn Graybrook during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR.
Chelnadatilar was a gold dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR.
Darahl Tilvenar, also known as Darahl Firecloak, was a minor elven god of earth and fire magic.
The Black Tentacle was a Thayan ship on the Sea of Fallen Stars.

Deathdrinkers were powerful, non-tanar'ri demons spawned from vile pits of blood and gore. They were creatures of carnage that reveled in slaughter and collected the souls of those unfortunate enough to cross their paths.
Delshara Windhair, also known as the Witch of the Waves, was a powerful mage that lived on the island city-state of Orlumbor in the 14 century DR.

Demoriel was a demon. It was summoned to fight against Gage, a thief from Laothkund, by Sathra of the Shadow Tongue thieves' guild: the necromancer called it by name. It was a black, humanoid, scaled creature, with inky teeth and claws. Wielding Angul, Gage managed to slay Demoriel, but it was a tough fight: the demon showed the power to scream abyssal curses to liquify stone and metal.
The Black Hand of Bane, preferred weapon of the tyrant god Bane, was a +5 axiomatic mighty cleaving unholy gauntlet.

Dhergoloths(), often called dergholoths, derghodaemons, or derghodemons, were brutish yugoloths one step above the mezzoloths in the daemon hierarchy. Like their inferiors, they were insectoid soldiers that worked within mercenary armies, but had more limbs and greater strength at the cost of a lesser intellect.
Dirlagraun () was an aged displacer beast that traveled across the planes of existence with the Witchlight Carnival.
The Dodkong (meaning "Deathking" in Giant) was the stone giant ruler of Cairnheim, and also a powerful lich.
A Blingdenstone warpick was an enchanted weapon from the deep gnome city of Blingdenstone.
Djinn (; ) were a type of genie native to the Elemental Plane of Air.
A displacer beast, also known as a dirlagraun or omlarcat, was a predatory feline monstrous magical beast.
Dorn Graybrook was a human half–iron golem adventurer who became involved in the events of the Rage of Dragons of Year of Rogue Dragons, 1373 DR.
Blackrazor was a sword with powerful enchantments but an evil nature.
Druth Daern was a lich in Myth Drannor in the Year of the Tankard, 1370 DR.
Falsifax was an odd fire reaver that prowled the High Road of Cormyr during the late 15 century DR.
A feng huang, sometimes called the oriental phoenix, was a magnificent avian creature. They were rarely found in the Prime Material plane.

Blade thirst was a spell that allowed a slashing weapon being wielded by a ranger to gain a +3 bonus and glow with a blue flame. The earlier version of this spell was an alteration spell called bladethirst. It was usable by wizards and worked on any single-edge blade.
Fell trolls, otherwise known as giant two-headed trolls, were one of the largest types of trolls in the Realms. Some believed that they were a cross-breed between trolls and ettins.
Finguld Boomer Felloki was a frost giant warrior in the late 15th century DR.
Ferzath was a black dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR.

The ritual of Blade-rite (or Blade Rite) was an elven ritual that involved the drawing of a magical sword to determine the worthiness of its wielder for a given assignment or position among the hierarchy of the elves. It was most closely associated with the drawing of the famous Elfblades—the Artblade, Warblade and Crownblade—used to determine the Coronal of Cormanthyr, and his two Defenders, the Arms-Major and the Spell-Major.
Fetitia Ledora was a half-elven incantatrix who founded the Sorority of the Silver Fire, alongside Yhelfanna the Masked, in her quest for revenge against the Cult of the Dragon.

Flame snakes, also known as fire snakes, were a type of magical snake with three sub-species that were tied to the element of fire and related to the great serpent Apep. These sub-species were referred to as the minor, lesser, and greater species.
Flamefang was a large and powerful hell hound in the world of Eberron.
Blade barrier was an evocation spell that summoned a wall of spinning, razor-sharp blades of force.

Foo creatures were powerful leonine celestials who would sometimes act as guardians for good beings. Statues of foo creatures were often portrayed as guarding buildings in Shou architecture, such as in the Shou Embassy on the Rock of Bral.
Fracto-Nimbuli was a cloud giant ally of Yrkhetep in Chondath in 1357 DR.
G'Zhorb, which roughly translated to the All-Seeing Eye in the Beholder language, was a powerful beholder in Undermountain beneath Waterdeep.
Bless weapon was a transmutation spell that grants a weapon a temporary holy aura.
Fuigarm was a mute giant who served as bodyguard to Aman Al-Raqib of Bralizzar near the Raurin in the mid–14 century DR.
Frostmaw the Silent Hunger was a winter wolf and one of the pain-bringers of the Slaughterhouse Arena of Tyraturos at the very end of the 15 century DR.

The Abomination is an enemy featured in Call of Duty: Mobile Zombies. It is the final boss of the Raid mode in Shi No Numa. The boss battle takes place on either Round 9 or 12, depending on whether the Raid is on Normal or Hard mode.
The Blade and Stars was an inn in Baldur's Gate on the Sword Coast of Faerûn.

The Deathclaw is an enemy from the Fallout series. Deathclaws are featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 during the Fallout event in various capacities. They appeared as a Scorestreak within The Ghouls Multiplayer game mode, and as enemies in both the Project RADS Zombies game mode and the Deathclaw Hunt World Event in Endgame.

The Doom Slayer, real name Flynn Taggart, and also known as Doomguy, is the protagonist of the Doom franchise. The Doom Slayer is featured as an Operator of the JSOC faction in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. He was released during Season Six of Black Ops 7 on September 24th, 2026 as part of the Doom Event Pass Premium Track Offering.

Sun Wukong, also known as the Monkey King, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online. Sun Wukong is a legendary figure from Chinese mythology, originating from the classic novel Journey to the West.

A blade of banishing was a magical dagger that was able to destroy magical barriers, illusions, or protections upon coming in contact with them. The dagger was always active, it could not be "switched off", and would have this effect whether or not it was being wielded, or if it was drawn. It simply needed to come into contact with the magic against which it was acting. A blade such as this was worth around 5,000 gold pieces as of 1368 DR.

The Orda (Russian: Орда, lit. Horde), also called Elder Gods, Overlords, and Giants, and also known as Hulking Summoners in the game files are a type of creature introduced within Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. An Orda first made an appearance as an Easter Egg within Die Maschine and later appears as an enemy within Firebase Z and Outbreak. An Orda appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 at the Orda Graveyard within the Fog in Ashes of the Damned.

The Panzermörder (English: Armor-Killer) is the final boss in the Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies map The Final Reich. A Panzermörder can be seen in the intro cutscene of The Tortured Path, attacking London alongside a horde of Zombies. Another Panzermörder appears in the opening cutscene of The Frozen Dawn.

The is a character from the franchise. The T-1000 is featured as an Operator of the Terminators faction in Call of Duty: Vanguard, as well as a playable character in Call of Duty: Mobile. In Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone, the T-1000 was released during Season Four Reloaded on August 1st, 2022 as part of the "Tracer Pack: Terminator T-1000 Ultra Operator - Limited Time Bundle". In Call of Duty: Mobile, he was released on August 6th, 2026 during Season 7: Terminated as part of "The Judgement Day - It Goes Two T-1000 Selectable" bundle.
A blade was a type of sharp-edged melee weapon. Blades, particularly swords and daggers, were used throughout Faerûn and beyond.

The Guardian was a colossal stone golem that served as the guardian of the Obscurus Altilium. It appears as the final boss of the Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 Zombies map Citadelle des Morts. The Guardian is also featured as an enemy in the Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Dead Ops Arcade map, Dead Ops Arcade 4: Papaback in Black where it is known as The Burning Knight. It later makes an appearance as a boss in Rex Infernus as part of the Playdate with the Twins Super Easter Egg.

Huntress Wizard (from Adventure Time) is a Super Rare ally in Bloons Adventure Time TD that costs $550 to place. She uses her magical bow to pop bloons. She can only be equipped to Ice King, Sam, Finn, and Dungeon Finn.
Annyce is a Breton werewolf. She is part of the trio of bosses found at The Wolf's Camp.
The Blade Dlardrageth was an enchanted broadsword wielded by Xhalph Dlardrageth in the late 14 century DR.

Arum-Khal, also known as the Dark Adept, is a Khajiit Dro-m'Athra lich found at the Ashen Scar scar in Northern Elsweyr. Originally an adept of the Order of the Hidden Moon, he turned away from Azurah in a quest for power, betraying his best friend and brother Shando-ri.

Balreth is a large undead creature, and one of the Brothers of Strife. Prior to being transformed into an undead monster, General Balreth was a Chimer general of the Chimeri Armed Forces during the last battle of the Nede-Chimer War. Together with his brother, Legate Sadal, he sacrificed himself, becoming the Brothers of Strife. He serves as one of the two main antagonists of the Stonefalls region, along with his brother Sadal.
Bavura the Blizzard is a senche-tiger found at Nindaeril's Perch in Grahtwood.
Blaine was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North.

Birdfolk, also known as Bird men and Cyrodilic bird-people, were a race of beastfolk who resided in the Eight Islands of Cyrod during the Merethic Era. Any name they may have given themselves is lost to history.
Blaise Sette is buried in the New Sheoth Graveyard, with the headstone reading, "Here lies Blaise Sette. Faster than the wind, dumber than a stump."
Bol Veppik is a powerful spiritual Spider Daedra found inside the ruins of Skyreach Pinnacle.
Blade ward was an abjuration cantrip spell that gave a brief resistance to weapon attacks.
Brandish is a Breton mage who specializes in Destruction magic. He can only be found inside Fort Neugrad behind a locked door. He uses up to three Destruction spells.
Captain Martio Calsivius is an Imperial sun mage located at the Halls of Colossus in .
The Celestial Mage is a being of immense power plummeted from the sky in . It commands a torrent of atronachs defiling the land in the east of Craglorn.
Blinding smite was an evocation spell that made the next hit with a melee weapon create a explosion of light and radiant damage against the target.
